title: Photoabsorption of 1–2 nm molecular Ce oxo clusters versus ceria: intervalence charge transfer but no size effects

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen using Schlenk and glovebox techniques, dried cerium ammonium nitrate was dissolved in THF. A THF solution of sodium tert-butoxide was added slowly. The precipitate was filtered and washed with pentane; solvent was removed under vacuum. The residue was redissolved in heptane, stirred for 96 h and stored at 20 °C to form yellow needles, which were decanted and vacuum-dried.
synthesis.temperature: Cerium ammonium nitrate dried at 120 °C; crystallization at 20 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Air-free Schlenk and glovebox preparation under nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter, wash with pentane, remove solvent, recrystallize from heptane, decant and vacuum-dry.
synthesis.yield: 1.85 g, 1.58 mmol; 48% relative to Ce in cerium ammonium nitrate

properties.summary: The cluster exhibits an oxygen-to-cerium charge-transfer absorption without a visible intervalence charge-transfer band.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion; Fig. 1 and Fig. 5
Synthesis and characterisation of compounds, Ce3

synthesis.procedure: Cerium nitrate hexahydrate was dissolved in acetonitrile and water. Pivalic acid and pyridine were added and stirred for 1 h. A solution of cerium ammonium nitrate in acetonitrile was added; the mixture was stirred for another 4 h and left overnight. The pale-yellow precipitate was filtered and vacuum-dried.
synthesis.time: 1 h, then 4 h stirring and overnight standing
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the precipitate and dry under vacuum.
synthesis.yield: 250 mg; 69% relative to Ce(IV) starting material, 11% relative to total Ce

properties.summary: Its absorption is assigned to oxygen-to-cerium charge transfer, with no visible intervalence charge-transfer band.

measurements.name: charge-transfer absorption onset

synthesis.procedure: Benzoic acid was dissolved in pyridine/water; cerium nitrate hexahydrate was added and stirred for 30 min, followed by cerium ammonium nitrate and 1 h stirring. The solution was layered with acetone to crystallize the cluster.
synthesis.time: 30 min plus 1 h stirring; crystals after 2 weeks; isolation after 4 weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Layer with acetone; filter crystals and dry under vacuum. Single crystals were retained in mother liquor.
